en.title: Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' Smashes BFI IMAX Record, Tops Star Wars Debut
en.summary: Christopher Nolan's latest epic, 'The Odyssey,' has achieved a monumental opening at London's BFI IMAX, shattering previous records. The film's immense popularity has cemented the venue's status as the top-grossing IMAX location globally.
en.body:
Christopher Nolan has once again demonstrated his unparalleled command of the cinematic spectacle. His highly anticipated film, **'The Odyssey,'** has achieved an astonishing feat, obliterating box office records during its opening weekend at London's iconic BFI IMAX. In a stunning display of fan devotion and the allure of the big screen, the film sold an incredible 28,000 tickets within its first 24 hours, a number that has propelled the BFI IMAX to become the number one IMAX venue internationally. This remarkable debut has even surpassed the opening weekend performance of **'Star Wars: The Force Awakens,'** a previous record-holder for the venue.

The sheer demand for **'The Odyssey'** at the BFI IMAX, the UK's largest screen, resulted in an astounding $1 million in ticket sales within its initial 24-hour period. This figure, translating to approximately £750,000, highlights not only the film's immense draw but also the audience's eagerness to experience Nolan's vision in the most immersive format possible. The queues of fans lining up for sold-out screenings are a testament to the director's consistent ability to create cinematic events that transcend typical moviegoing.

## A New Benchmark for Blockbuster Openings

The success of **'The Odyssey'** at the BFI IMAX is more than just a personal triumph for Christopher Nolan; it's a significant moment for theatrical exhibition. In an era where streaming services often dominate headlines, this record-breaking performance reaffirms the enduring appeal of the communal cinema experience, particularly when paired with groundbreaking filmmaking. The film's ability to command such attention and generate these numbers speaks volumes about its perceived quality and the public's desire for ambitious, large-scale storytelling.

As an editorial arm of WeCult, a global premium entertainment platform, we understand the passion of smart, engaged fans. This kind of reception for **'The Odyssey'** is exactly what excites us. It’s a reminder that when filmmakers deliver truly compelling and visually stunning narratives, audiences will respond with overwhelming enthusiasm. The film’s critical reception, coupled with this box office dominance, sets a high bar for future releases and solidifies its place as a major cinematic achievement.

## What's Next

Fans eager to experience **'The Odyssey'** on the grandest scale possible will have the opportunity to do so through IMAX 70mm screenings, beginning July 17, 2026. Further details regarding these special engagements, including specific showtimes and locations beyond the initial BFI IMAX run, are expected to be announced in the coming months.

content_raw: The U.K.'s largest screen has become the number one Imax venue internationally thanks to Christopher Nolan's latest epic.
